summary: Full Pulse brand-guidelines sweep across all 6 authenticated modules + public landing. Real Playwright login as owner@isodemo.com/IsoDemo123!, dismissed cookie banner, then visited /dashboard, /crm, /memberships, /marketing, /comms and /service-desk. On each route ran a runtime computed-style scan across up to 4000 DOM nodes for the 6 banned brand colours (rgb(37,99,235) navy blue-600, rgb(124,58,237) violet-600, rgb(147,51,234) purple-600, rgb(168,85,247) purple-500, rgb(79,70,229) indigo-600, rgb(20,184,166) teal-500) and simultaneously counted Core Blue cyan family occurrences (#19CDFF/#0091ca/#0073a4). RESULT: ZERO banned colours on every authenticated route. Core Blue cyan is heavily present on every route (254/194/47+27/287/4/28+40 hits respectively on dashboard/crm/memberships/marketing/comms/service-desk), confirming accent elements (buttons, badges, KPI icons, tabs, links) all resolve to the Pulse cyan scale. Font check via getComputedStyle: body and H1 headings and buttons on every authenticated route resolve to '"Proxima Nova", Inter, system-ui, ...' — Proxima Nova is now the default app font as required. All 6 authenticated pages rendered with a visible H1 (Operations, CRM, Memberships, Marketing, Comms Centre, Service Desk) — no blank screens, no JS runtime errors from app code. Public landing page (/) confirmed via data-testid='pulse-landing-page', renders on-brand (cyan hero, correct hero copy 'Manage your gym. In one place.', LOG IN + GET STARTED CTAs, Pulse Fitness logo, Sign In pill, KPI card with Jobs Logged/Check Sheets Completed/Saved via Self-Fix, cookie banner) — visually intact and unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind hue-collapse (aliasing blue/sky/cyan/indigo/violet/purple/teal → PULSE_ACCENT cyan scale) is a clean single-config fix that flipped hundreds of utility usages without touching component code. Runtime confirms it works — zero banned rgb values across 6 modules × up to 4000 nodes = ~24k node-samples.
Proxima Nova default in index.css + landing's data-testid='pulse-landing-page' Montserrat/Nunito type classes correctly coexist — landing visual is intact.

Only console noise observed is pre-existing CSP script blocks for third-party emergent-main.js / posthog / cloudflareinsights beacons — infrastructure/preview-env, not app bugs, and unrelated to this branding change.

success_rate.frontend: Branding compliance 100% (0/6 banned colours on 6/6 modules) · Typography 100% (Proxima Nova on body+H1+button on 6/6 modules) · Page render 6/6 modules · Landing page intact
